value.rationale: The full lattice of two-sided linear ideals is a central structural invariant of any finite-dimensional algebra, unlike arbitrary slices or one-off numerical tests. Rectangular bands are semigroup-simple but their algebras have a radical with cube zero and a rich family of linear ideals. The classification resolves all subideals at once over every field, describes the corresponding geometric moduli, and gives an exact dimension-by-dimension Gaussian census over every finite field. None of these follows merely from knowing the Jacobson radical or semigroup congruences.
